name: Monks Gang
description: Not considered an actual street gang, the Monks were one of the most hated South Side Chicago crews of the 1970s, active in the Back of the Yards area near railroad tracks at 2200 West, between 55th and 49th streets. Members were sometimes seen wearing a black monks cowl or hood. They were known for sniffing glue and allegedly dabbling in Satanism, including alleged animal sacrifices on the railroad tracks. On at least one occasion, a large group of neighborhood youths conducted an armed sweep of suspected Monk hangouts.
